text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Two other Umamusume debut several months after Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As both friends and worthy rivals, Narita Taishin believes in them, and the three all have their sights set on the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin's determined not to lose and throws herself into training to prepare for the inevitable battles against her companions.
